task_completion.description: Open the 'Fly Brain' sample image stack in Fiji/ImageJ.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An ImageJ window titled 'Fly Brain' showing a multi-slice stack (indicated by a slider at the bottom) with dimensions 256x256x57.

task_completion.description: Convert the image stack to 8-bit grayscale.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The image window header or information bar displays '8-bit' instead of the original bit depth (e.g., 16-bit or RGB).

task_completion.description: Perform the 'Reslice' operation from the 'Top' with 1.0 pixel spacing.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Reslice' dialog box with 'Start at: Top' and 'Output Spacing: 1.0' selected, followed by a new stack window appearing (likely titled 'Reslice of Fly Brain').

task_completion.description: Create a Maximum Intensity Projection of the resliced stack.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Z Project' dialog with 'Projection type: Maximum Intensity' selected, resulting in a single 2D image window (no slider at the bottom).

task_completion.description: Save the final projection as 'side_view_projection.tif' in the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save' or 'Save As' dialog showing the path '~/ImageJ_Data/results/side_view_projection.tif' or the file appearing in a file explorer window at that location.

integrity.description: The agent used the ImageJ GUI menus rather than just executing a script or terminal command.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor navigating 'Image > Type > 8-bit', 'Image > Stacks > Reslice', and 'Image > Stacks > Z Project'.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename an existing file or create a dummy image.
integrity.visual_evidence: Intermediate windows (the resliced stack and the projection window) are visible on the desktop before the final save.

integrity.description: The final image dimensions match the expected output of the reslicing process.
integrity.visual_evidence: The final image window header shows dimensions of 256x57 pixels.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'Fly Brain' sample is a 256x256x57 stack. Converting to 8-bit is required before reslicing. Reslicing from the 'Top' transforms the Y-axis into the Z-axis; since the original depth was 57 and width was 256, the resulting XZ projection must be exactly 256x57 pixels. The final file must be an 8-bit TIFF named 'side_view_projection.tif' located in '~/ImageJ_Data/results/'.
